notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, moving a counter from target creature onto another creature.
Repeat.
